headline: Nestlé Nigeria Seeks Approval for Waters Business Transfer to JV
summary: Nestlé Nigeria Plc is seeking regulatory approval to transfer its waters and premium beverages business to Peranel, a 50:50 joint venture with Platinum Equity.
why: Nestlé Nigeria is a major food and beverage manufacturing company listed on the Nigerian Exchange.

impacts.name: Nestlé Nigeria Plc
impacts.why: Restructuring business lines into joint ventures shifts operational asset ownership and capital allocation.
